source:
@@U03786@@
This—my hand.

@@U03788@@
Who would reproach our mistress for showing this castle’s lord her loving favor? We're captives, every one of us, not once but many times since the shameful fall of 特洛伊 and the dreaded labyrinthine trials of our endless journey. Women, accustomed to lovers, may be experts, but they can’t be choosers. They take whatever opportunity offers, giving their voluptuous limbs alike to golden-haired shepherd boys and bristly, black fauns. Look, they're already drawing closer, leaning together, shoulder to shoulder, knee to knee, hand in hand as they rock to and fro on the grandly cushioned throne, unashamed of displaying their Majesty's secret affections to the sight of their people.

@@U03790@@
I feel so far away, and yet so near; What joy it is to say: I’m here, I’m here!

@@U03792@@
My breath is short, my words no longer free; It’s all a dream; time, place have ceased to be.

@@U03794@@
I seem to be long past, and yet so new; Bound fast with you and to a stranger true.
translation:
@@U03786@@
这——我的手。

@@U03788@@
谁会责备我们的女主人对这座城堡领主的宠爱呢？自从特洛伊可耻的陷落以及我们无尽旅程中可怕的迷宫考验以来，我们每个人都成为俘虏，不是一次，而是很多次。习惯了情人的女人也许是专家，但她们不可能是挑剔者。他们抓住一切机会，将自己性感的四肢献给金发牧童和毛茸茸的黑色农牧神。看，他们已经靠得更近了，肩并肩、膝对膝、手拉手地靠在一起，在铺着豪华坐垫的王座上来回摇晃，毫不羞耻地在人民面前展示了陛下的秘密感情。

@@U03790@@
我感觉距离很远，又很近；说：我在这里，我在这里，这是多么令人高兴啊！

@@U03792@@
我的呼吸急促，我的言语不再自由；一切都是梦；时间、地点都已不复存在。

@@U03794@@
我似乎已经过去很久了，却又如此新鲜；与你和陌生人紧密相连。
